scope: Bind the modeler entity identities, source model-space role, AcDs schema and data-index locations, and exact SAB carrier bytes in one public AC1027 DWG to an independent ODA-produced DXF. This is not native 3D semantic evidence.

source.provenance_limit: The public drawing's original authoring application and production history are not established.

source_entity_role.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 20.2 and 20.4.1
source_entity_role.rule: Entmode 2 is model space without an owner handle; R2013+ common entity data includes the Has DS binary data bit.
source_entity_role.physical_observation: The raw entity frames have graphic flag zero and entmode bits 10 (source bit 37 for handles 0x176 and 0x2E1; bit 111 after one bounded EED chunk for 0x37D). All three have Has DS binary data=1. The same source supplies exactly one case-folded *MODEL_SPACE BLOCK_RECORD, handle 0x1F. ODA DXF places the corresponding entities in ENTITIES with group-330 owner 0x1F.
source_entity_role.boundary: Source model-space ownership is established by the entmode role and unique source block record; these entity frames do not carry an explicit owner handle, and the typed parentHandle remains zero.

physical_acds.record_note: Tuples are schema index, segment index and local index offset. These three modeled records are inline, and their extracted section slices match the typed payload exactly.
physical_acds.other_record: The schema-0 thumbnail record 0x22 also matches the ODA output byte-for-byte, but is not a modeler entity.

independent_oda.product: ODA File Converter 27.1.0, verified macOS ARM64 application
independent_oda.result: All three same-handle entity type, schema, payload length and complete assembled group-310 payloads agree byte-for-byte. Each starts with ACIS BinaryFile. The 3DSOLID source history handle and DXF group 350 both equal 0x2E4.

harness.source_build: Clean git-archive source of commit df7d6017 with these two added harness files; separate Debug CMake build. The extraction uses the current library, and ODA is the independently implemented output path.
harness.target_policy: EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL; no external sample is part of ordinary builds or tests.
harness.result: PASS: all three entities and complete SAB payloads match; fixed source SHA and decoded AcDs section SHA and caller-supplied DXF SHA are checked before join.
harness.focused_validation: CTest libdxfrw_ac1027_acds_source_compare_self_test passed with a locally generated entity prefix, mode/storage flag mutations and truncation. Mutations to the actual probe output for model-space mode, DataStorage handle and one payload byte were separately rejected. Input/frame/output byte bounds are enforced.

limitations: This is physical source association and carrier-byte transport evidence for one AC1027 input and one ODA conversion, not complete graph, writer replay or broad producer/version qualification.
The source conversion still reports three object parse failures and one orphan DataStorage record; strict complete DXF output remains refused.
Neither independent-kernel topology/placement nor native FreeCAD/LibreCAD or other 3D consumer acceptance was tested. No support claims follow.
No DWG, DXF or extracted SAB fixture was added to the repository.
